results.question: What is CSS?
unsupported_claims: CSS was created to solve the limitations of HTML in terms of presentation and layout.
results.judge_reason: The answer provides a clear and concise definition of CSS, directly addressing the question.
results.answer: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is the language we use to style an HTML document. [1]

results.question: What are the benefits of CSS?
results.judge_reason: The answer provides a comprehensive list of benefits of CSS, covering various aspects such as separation of content and presentation, consistency, and user experience.
results.answer:
The benefits of CSS include:
• Separation of Content and Presentation [1]
• Consistency Across Pages [2]
• Improved Page Load Times [2]

• Greater Design Flexibility [3]
• Accessibility [3]

results.question: What happens when selectors have different specificity?
results.judge_reason: The answer explains what happens when selectors have different specificity, but it doesn't fully address the question as it only mentions the outcome, not the implications or further details.
results.answer: When there are two or more CSS rules that point to the same element, the selector with the highest specificity will "win", and its style declaration will be applied to that HTML element. [1]

results.question: What are CSS gradients?

results.answer: CSS gradients let you display smooth transitions between two or more specified colors. [1]
